Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism table. Join compound_records on substrate_record_id to get substrate compound name. Join molecule_dictionary on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on drug_record_id to get parent compound name. Filter organism equals Canis lupus familiaris. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Limit 200.
